svg.title: Fibroblasts in cardiac fibrosis
svg.desc: Editable 16:9 evidence synthesis of the two fibroblast workbook sheets and matching CSV. Fifty extracted records are grouped into resident origins and fibroblast states, biochemical and cellular activation, matrix mechanics and experimental repair. The graphic corrects selected extraction errors, distinguishes experimental results from spatial or trajectory inference, and provides clickable paper citations. Citation 43 is unresolved and is not treated as independent evidence.

g.data-finding-ids: CF002-FB-F01 CF013-FB-F01 CF029-FB-F01 CF031-FB-F01 CF034-FB-F01 FORTE20-FB-F01 REV03-FB-F01 REV04-FB-F01 REV05-FB-F01
g.title:
Resident cardiac fibroblasts predominate as the source of scar myofibroblasts. LepR-lineage adventitial cells preferentially expand after MI. Common mouse-MI states include resident, injury-responsive/cycling, contractile myofibroblast and scar-adapted matrifibrocyte programs. This is a contextual sequence, not a universal human fate map. The unresolved supplied review 43 is not independent support.
Original extracted record IDs: CF002-FB-F01, CF013-FB-F01, CF029-FB-F01, CF031-FB-F01, CF034-FB-F01, FORTE20-FB-F01, REV03-FB-F01, REV04-FB-F01, REV05-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.
g.desc: Resident cardiac fibroblasts predominate as the source of scar myofibroblasts. LepR-lineage adventitial cells preferentially expand after MI. Common mouse-MI states include resident, injury-responsive/cycling, contractile myofibroblast and scar-adapted matrifibrocyte programs. This is a contextual sequence, not a universal human fate map. The unresolved supplied review 43 is not independent support.
g.text: Resident fibroblasts build the scar
TCF21+ / PDGFRA+ resident lineages predominate.
LepR+ adventitial fibroblasts preferentially expand after MI.
Resident fibroblasts
Interstitial + adventitial niches
Activated / cycling states
Injury response; CILP / THBS4; α-SMA can be low
Contractile myofibroblasts
POSTN / ACTA2 / CTHRC1; collagen-rich matrix
Scar-adapted matrifibrocytes
COMP / SFRP2; α-SMA falls as the scar matures
Common MI sequence; states vary by model.

g.title:
Human ICM/MI scars and DCM display different spatial distributions of activated fibroblasts. Failing hearts share activated matrix programs; single-nucleus and spatial studies infer SCARA5-to-POSTN trajectories and show SPP1 macrophage/fibroblast colocalization. Simonson samples are from non-infarct LV, not an infarct-border sampling experiment. Colocalization and pseudotime are not causality or lineage proof.
Original extracted record IDs: CF001-FB-F01, CF004-FB-F01, KUPPE22-FB-F01, CHAFFIN22-FB-F01, RAO21-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.
g.desc: Human ICM/MI scars and DCM display different spatial distributions of activated fibroblasts. Failing hearts share activated matrix programs; single-nucleus and spatial studies infer SCARA5-to-POSTN trajectories and show SPP1 macrophage/fibroblast colocalization. Simonson samples are from non-infarct LV, not an infarct-border sampling experiment. Colocalization and pseudotime are not causality or lineage proof.
g.text: Human fibrosis has spatially distinct states
MI / ICM: focal scar niches
DCM: interstitial remodeling
Shared POSTN / THBS4 / FAP activation across failing hearts.
SCARA5 → POSTN trajectories and SPP1+ macrophage
neighborhoods are inferred or spatially observed.

g.title:
AngII stress can expand THBS4/CILP activated fibroblasts without high ACTA2. Proliferation, matrix synthesis and contractile differentiation can be dissociated. Endothelial lactate/Snail1 and PFKFB3 studies report mesenchymal programs, while inducible endothelial fate maps support retained EC identity or reversible activation. Marker co-expression does not establish durable EC-to-FB conversion.
Original extracted record IDs: CF026-FB-F01, CF058-FB-F01, CF061-FB-F01, CF063-FB-F01, REV01-FB-F01, ZHANG21-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.
g.desc: AngII stress can expand THBS4/CILP activated fibroblasts without high ACTA2. Proliferation, matrix synthesis and contractile differentiation can be dissociated. Endothelial lactate/Snail1 and PFKFB3 studies report mesenchymal programs, while inducible endothelial fate maps support retained EC identity or reversible activation. Marker co-expression does not establish durable EC-to-FB conversion.
g.text: Activation is multidimensional
Proliferation ≠ α-SMA ≠ matrix production.
AngII expands THBS4+ / CILP+ states with low α-SMA.
Endothelial lactate–Snail1 and PFKFB3 pathways induce
mesenchymal markers, but marker overlap does not prove
a lasting contribution to the scar fibroblast lineage.

g.title:
TGF-beta signaling drives matrix-associated and myofibroblast programs. BAG3 restrains TGFBR2 via protein degradation; SMAD7 limits downstream SMAD and ErbB2 pathways; HTRA3 restrains TGF-beta, connecting fibroblast state to cardiomyocyte stress and IGFBP7. TEAD1 and conserved BNC2/NFAT5/CREB3L2 networks regulate fibroblast activation. Mechanical pathways also act through FAK/RhoA, YAP/TAZ and MRTF/SRF.
Original extracted record IDs: CF012-FB-F01, CF017-FB-F01, CF020-FB-F01, CF021-FB-F01, CF060-FB-F01, REV02-FB-F01, REV06-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.

g.title:
Macrophage subsets have different effects. CCL24 activates fibroblast CCR3/PI3K/AKT and TGF-beta release; DNMT3A-deficient myeloid cells signal through HB-EGF; macrophage-intrinsic miR-21 regulates a profibrotic secretome. Human FN1+ pericardial macrophage cystatin C reduces fibroblast contraction; TREM2/efferocytosis/itaconate supports reparative fibroblast proliferation. Resident macrophages can limit early TAC fibrosis. miR-21 microparticle transfer is not asserted.
Original extracted record IDs: CF038-FB-F01, CF041-FB-F01, CF042-FB-F01, CF043-FB-F01, CF050-FB-F01, CF051-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.

g.title:
Cardiomyocyte EV miR-24-3p inhibits fibroblast FURIN/CCND1/SMAD4 and activation; ischemia depletes this inhibitory cargo. CM senescence is linked to adverse remodeling and is tested through CM p16 deletion. RGS5-deficient pericyte secretome activates FBs through TGF-beta2, not demonstrated transdifferentiation. Activated FB exosomal miR-200a-3p impairs endothelial angiogenic function. Spatial vascular cue imbalance is an association or prediction.
Original extracted record IDs: CF059-FB-F01, CF062-FB-F01, CF066-FB-F01, CF068-FB-F01, CF074-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.

Activated FB exosomal miR-200a-3p impairs endothelial angiogenic function. Spatial vascular cue imbalance is an association or prediction.

g.title:
Miyara et al. describe cold fibrosis with myofibroblast persistence and fewer activated macrophages after acute MI, versus hot fibrosis with coexisting activated macrophages/myofibroblasts during chronic stress. TIMP1 supports an autocrine myofibroblast circuit; antibody inhibition reduces proliferation and scarring in mouse MI. These are study/model-dependent patterns, not a universal binary diagnosis.
Original extracted record IDs: CF037-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.

g.data-finding-ids: CF015-FB-F01 CF018-FB-F01 CF034-FB-F01 CF037-FB-F01 CF038-FB-F01 CF068-FB-F01 CF090-FB-F01 REV01-FB-F01 REV04-FB-F01 REV05-FB-F01 REV06-FB-F01 THAVA20-FB-F01
g.title:
PDGF-AB modulates myofibroblast differentiation, collagen composition and scar organization in human cells and preclinical MI studies; it is not equivalent to PDGF-BB and does not universally suppress collagen genes. CCL24/CCR3 and TIMP1 blockade reduce experimental fibrosis in their stated settings. Pirfenidone has selective human engineered-tissue effects, with incomplete TGF-beta reversal. CM p16 loss reduces scarring in mouse MI. Early fibroblast-mediated scar formation is protective; complete suppression may compromise repair. Unresolved review 43 is not independent evidence.
Original extracted record IDs: CF015-FB-F01, CF018-FB-F01, CF034-FB-F01, CF037-FB-F01, CF038-FB-F01, CF068-FB-F01, CF090-FB-F01, REV01-FB-F01, REV04-FB-F01, REV05-FB-F01, REV06-FB-F01, THAVA20-FB-F01. Original claims and curation notes are preserved in the SVG metadata; original claims are not all endorsed.

CM p16 loss reduces scarring in mouse MI. Early fibroblast-mediated scar formation is protective; complete suppression may compromise repair. Unresolved review 43 is not independent evidence.
